# dsm_share_permission (Data Source)

Read-only data source for looking up an existing DSM share permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dsm_share_permission" "developers" {
  share_name      = "team-data"
  user_group_type = "local_group"
  principal_name  = "developers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `principal_name` (String) User or group name.
- `share_name` (String) Name of the shared folder.
- `user_group_type` (String) Type of principal: local_user or local_group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier: share_name:user_group_type:principal_name.
- `permission` (String) Permission level: read_only, read_write, or no_access.
